record.question: As he was poor I helped him.
record.explanation: Answer D: conjunction. As introduces the subordinate causal clause “as he was poor,” so it is a conjunction (D). Independent check: “As” introduces the subordinate reason clause “as he was poor,” functioning as a subordinating conjunction.
